name: P2Predict
description: Local MCP server for parametric price benchmarking in procurement and engineering. Trains a model on your own purchasing history to predict what a part should cost, attribute the price to spec/supplier drivers, and return a calibrated likely-price range — nothing leaves your machine.
author: Ahmed Khalil Hafsi

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List all trained P2Predict models in the configured models directory.

tools.name: get_model_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific model.

tools.name: predict
tools.description: Predict the target value (e.g. price) for a single part.

tools.name: predict_batch
tools.description: Predict prices for many parts at once, optionally with explanations.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Explain what is driving a part's predicted price, spec by spec.

tools.name: predict_interval
tools.description: Predict with a likely range (conformal prediction interval).

tools.name: what_if
tools.description: Re-run a prediction after changing one or more specs/supplier to see the price delta.

tools.name: predict_from_csv
tools.description: Run predictions for every row in a CSV of parts.

tools.name: propose_training_plan
tools.description: Inspect a training CSV and return a plain-language plan before training.

tools.name: train
tools.description: Train a new price-prediction model on a spec-and-price CSV.

tools.name: get_model_quality
tools.description: Structured, agent-readable model-quality report — is this model trustworthy?

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Generate a procurement-style model-quality PDF report.
